rows.question: Why can the same 30-day fill cost more at a standard pharmacy than a preferred one on this plan?
rows.answer: For this plan and period, the matched 30-day metformin 500 mg supply is $8 at preferred retail and $27 at standard retail under the recorded conditions. Preferred retail and standard retail are different cost-share categories for the same days supply when the network classification on the date of service differs. The difference is the category that applied at that pharmacy on that date, not a change to the written prescription.
